description:
Record a refund for an invoice on PayPal.

This function records a refund against an invoice, by invoice ID. If all payments made against the invoice are refunded, PayPal marks the invoice REFUNDED; otherwise it is marked PARTIALLY_REFUNDED. This does not process a new refund -- it only logs one that was already issued.

method is required.

Checked by fizzl-paypal-guard before it runs: the owner approves or denies each one.

inputSchema.description: Record a refund against an invoice.

amount.description: The currency and amount for a financial transaction.

currency_code.description: The three-character ISO-4217 currency code that identifies the currency.

value.description: The amount, as a signed decimal string with up to 2 decimal places (e.g. '50.00').

invoice_id.description: The ID of the invoice to mark as refunded.

method.description: The payment mode or method through which the invoicer can accept the payments.

refund_date.description: The date when the invoicer recorded the refund, in yyyy-MM-dd format.

name: record_refund_for_invoice
